free_text: The decision leans towards biopsy because the EXPERT-PROTOCOL criterion mandates it when the mpMRI shows a PI-RADS 4 lesion, which was retrieved. This finding overturned the STATISTICAL PRIOR's suggestion of no biopsy by directly triggering the guideline threshold. Although the previous notes indicated an agreed surveillance pathway, the presence of a PI-RADS 4 lesion is a new, high-risk finding that necessitates sampling.
